summary: 69-year-old Colorado Springs man attempted the Manitou Incline during the March 13, 2019 bomb-cyclone blizzard despite a Tuesday city blizzard warning; CSFD Engines 5 and 13 assisted Manitou Springs FD in a scree evacuation of the underdressed hiker (27F, blowing snow, wind chill 17) with ~18 personnel; rescued with no injury reported
responding_agency: Colorado Springs FD (E5, E13) assisting Manitou Springs FD
notes: Date pin: blizzard warning issued Tuesday 3/12; rescue during 'this week's storm' = the 3/13 bomb cyclone (Wednesday-verified); CSFD PIO tweet dated 2019-03-13. Fills El Paso zero-row year 2019.
